title: Domain identity, URI, and reference contracts
objective: Stable ID families, canonical and source URIs, source locators, typed relations, and observation/claim contracts from the reference model exist as typed, validated, tested Python domain code aligned with the reference JSON Schemas.
business_value: Every durable claim in the product depends on precise, resolvable references; WP-200, WP-210, WP-230, and WP-300 all build on these contracts.
scope: Implement ID family contracts (parse, validate, format) for ART, EVD, EVD#OBS, TASK, TASK-STNN, DEC, RISK, Q, CLM, PER, SYS in src/workctx/domain/ids.py per doc-03

Implement the canonical entity-type vocabulary as a Python enum in src/workctx/domain/vocabulary.py containing exactly the 19 values fixed by decision D-018 (evidence, person, team, project, system, service, module, flow, integration, decision, risk, question, task, claim, draft, investigation, incident, observation, artifact)

Move canonical URI logic into src/workctx/domain/references.py, keeping src/workctx/models/reference.py as a compatibility shim so existing imports keep working; the WorkctxUri public API (parse, __str__, require_context) is frozen during Wave 1
Implement artifact://sha256/<digest> and repo://<repo-id>@<commit>/<path>#L<start>-L<end> source reference parsing/formatting in src/workctx/domain/references.py
Implement typed source-locator models (all 9 locator types) with ordering validation (end >= start) that JSON Schema cannot express, in src/workctx/domain/locators.py
Implement the typed-relation vocabulary as a Python enum aligned with schemas/reference.schema.json, in src/workctx/domain/relations.py

Implement typed Observation and Claim models in src/workctx/domain/observations.py and src/workctx/domain/claims.py aligned with schemas/observation.schema.json and schemas/claim.schema.json (kinds, confidence, supersession fields, source references with locators)
Document the observation-URI encoding rule: '#' must be percent-encoded (%23) in workctx:// URIs; hand-authored URIs with a literal '#' are rejected by parse — add a normalization helper and tests
Reject absolute machine paths and file:// schemes as durable references in code (doc-03 validation rule the schema cannot enforce)

Align schemas/reference.schema.json, schemas/source-locator.schema.json, schemas/observation.schema.json, and schemas/claim.schema.json with the implemented contracts via shared example fixtures, including negative fixtures per ADR 0008
non_goals: No SQLite indexing, retrieval, ranking, or context packs (WP-210, WP-230)
No resolver against stored workspace files (WP-200/WP-230); this package is in-memory contracts only
No CLI commands (WP-120 owns the CLI framework)
No edits to entity.schema.json, task.schema.json, context.schema.json, or other WP-110-owned schemas
No external URI connectors (jira://, confluence://, github://, dynatrace://) beyond a documented grammar placeholder (decision D-021 tracks the residue)
No claim-lifecycle logic (supersession application, temporal overlap resolution) — model shape and field validation only; WP-300/WP-400 own behavior
deliverables: Typed domain modules for IDs, entity-type vocabulary, URIs, locators, relations, observations, and claims with full unit tests
Compatibility shim keeping workctx.models.reference imports working
Shared example fixtures (positive and negative) validating against both JSON Schemas and Python models
Updated docs/reference/reference-system.md where implemented behavior clarifies the contract
Worker report.md and report.json in this work-order directory
acceptance_criteria: Every doc-03 ID family round-trips through parse/format with valid and invalid cases tested
The entity-type enum equals the D-018 19-value list exactly (test against the literal list, not against another branch's files)
workctx:// URIs with %23-encoded fragments round-trip; literal '#' input is rejected with an actionable error; normalization helper converts authoring form to canonical form
artifact:// and repo:// references parse and format per doc-03, with commit SHA required for repo references
All 9 locator types validate, including range-ordering rules the JSON Schema cannot express
Observation and Claim models round-trip fixtures against their schemas, including at least one negative fixture per model demonstrating a schema/model divergence would be caught
Absolute machine paths and file:// are rejected as durable references
security_constraints: Do not introduce secrets or private data in fixtures; fictional examples only
Path traversal segments must remain rejected in entity IDs
stop_conditions: Any change required to WorkctxUri's frozen public API
Any change required to WP-110-owned schemas or shared files listed as forbidden
Discovery that doc-03 semantics conflict with an existing ADR or with the D-018 vocabulary
